verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document any Hightouch capability to hash, mask, or filter sensitive attributes per destination as a privacy control. Per-sync field mapping and the warehouse-resident architecture are general data-movement and storage traits, not PII-governance features, so they are adjacent at best. Match booster actually expands the PII identifiers sent to ad platforms rather than restricting them.

support.subject: As a privacy lead, I can control PII flow per destination — hashing, masking, and field-level filtering of sensitive attributes
